status: G3 pilot: processed, compressed and reviewed; in the game in Chapters I and VII (desktop build, High)
use: A tower at the timber-walled camps' wall corners and beside the gate.

generator.prompt: A Roman timber watchtower for an army camp: four heavy squared corner posts with diagonal cross-bracing rising to a railed lookout platform about four metres up, under a small pitched roof of wooden shingles, with a ladder up one side. Weathered oak. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and strong readable silhouette, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.
